title: China in 26: Possible Trump-Xi-Putin meeting + export controls + fifth plenum
gist: MERICS German-language podcast episode in which Bernhard Bartsch, Mikko Huotari and Claudia Wessling discuss a supposedly planned Putin-Trump-Xi trilateral meeting, a suggested widening of Chinese export controls and the CCP's fifth plenum. The page is only an episode description with no substantive analysis.
